title: Comfort Club Reinstatement Grace Window After a Lapse
content:
Guidance on the reinstatement window for lapsed Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements. Clauses marked as no longer in force are superseded by the current basis and are not applied.

## In force

**Grace window.** A lapsed agreement may be reinstated only when the date of handling is no later than the tier's renewal grace days after the agreement's term end passed. Grace days are counted as calendar days starting the day after the term end, so the last day of grace is the term end date plus the renewal grace days; reinstating on that last day is inside the window. The agreement's status and term end date on record are the authority.

**Closure after grace.** A lapsed agreement not reinstated by the last day of grace is closed from lapsed to cancelled on the following day, and the customer must enroll a new agreement.

## No longer in force

- The former clause by which reinstatement returns the agreement to active and renews it exactly as an automatic renewal would, with the new term starting the day after the old term end so no gap is left and the consecutive term count continuing, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.
- The former clause by which a reinstatement fee at the tier's reinstatement fee is charged, a fee of 0.00 meaning no fee entry is posted, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.
- The former clause by which a reinstated agreement loses its price lock — its renewal dues using the current first-system annual rate, its locked rate reset to that rate where the tier carries a price lock, and the loyalty discount still applying when the count is reached — is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## Window boundary (hypothetical dates)

| Term end | Renewal grace | Last day of grace | Date of handling | Inside the window? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 31 May 2025 | 45 days | 15 July 2025 | 15 July 2025 | Yes (last day) |
| 31 May 2025 | 45 days | 15 July 2025 | 16 July 2025 | No — closed to cancelled on this day |
| 31 May 2025 | 30 days | 30 June 2025 | 30 June 2025 | Yes |
| 31 May 2025 | 30 days | 30 June 2025 | 1 July 2025 | No |

Day 1 of the grace period in these examples is 1 June 2025.

superseded_clauses: Reinstatement returns the agreement to active and renews it exactly as an automatic renewal would, with the new term starting the day after the old term_end so no gap is left, and consecutive_terms continues.
A reinstatement_fee of reinstatement_fee_usd is charged, and a fee of 0.00 means no fee entry is posted.

A reinstated agreement loses its price lock: its renewal dues use the current annual_dues_first_system_usd, and its locked_annual_rate is reset to that rate where the tier carries a price lock; the loyalty discount still applies when the count is reached.
